messages:
arjun: quick heads-up — i'm landing a terraform refactor to centralize provider blocks in the root module and pin module sources. opening PR to infra repo in a few mins.

arjun: main changes: move provider blocks out of each module into root, add required_providers in root, pin module versions in modules/*, regenerate .terraform.lock.hcl. will add migration steps in PR.

arjun: PR: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/412 (draft for now)

zoe: thanks! couple quick questions: does this affect workspaces/state? any manual migration steps we should schedule?

arjun: state stays where it is (same backend). the only risk is provider/plugin diffs causing different plans. plan is: 1) update code & lockfile in a branch, 2) run a manual plan per workspace, 3) if plan clean, merge during short cutover window. i'll include exact commands in the PR.

matt: are we pinning providers via required_providers constraints or relying on .terraform.lock.hcl? prefer constraints + lockfile so CI & local dev consistent.

arjun: yep doing both. example required_providers snippet i'm adding:
```hcl
terraform {
  required_providers {
    aws = {
      source  = "hashicorp/aws"
      version = "~> 4.0"
    }
  }
}
```
and module pins like:
```hcl
module "cache" {
  source = "git::https://github.com/redwood/terraform-modules.git//cache?ref=v2.3.1"
}
```

sasha: quick thought — can we prefer registry modules (registry.terraform.io) where possible? makes verification + future upgrades easier.

arjun: agreed — i'll convert any internal modules that exist in the registry to use registry source syntax where feasible.

luis: heads-up CI will blow up if lockfile and provider plugins don't match what's cached on the runners. i'll add a job to run `terraform init -upgrade -backend=false` and commit the regenerated .terraform.lock.hcl in the PR pipeline.

infra-bot: plan job: https://ci.redwood.com/job/infra/412/plan — plan finished with changes (viewable in job artifact).

zoe: can someone run a manual plan against prod workspace before we merge? want to confirm there are no provider-induced diffs that change resources.

arjun: i'll run the prod plan and paste the important parts. running:
```bash
TF_IN_AUTOMATION=1 terraform init -reconfigure -backend-config="bucket=redwood-terraform-prod"
terraform plan -out=plan.tfplan
terraform show -no-color plan.tfplan | head -n 120
```

arjun: sample lockfile entry i'm regenerating:
```hcl
provider "registry.terraform.io/hashicorp/aws" {
  version = "4.73.0"
  hashes = ["h1:...", "h1:..."]
}
```

matt: one nit on module pinning: prefer semver range `>= 2.0, < 3.0` for modules so minor/patch bumps are allowed, unless we need exact refs for breaking changes. also pls add a CHANGELOG note for infra.

sasha: +1 to changelog. also document the rollback steps (how to revert lockfile + provider constraints) in PR description.

arjun: updated the PR: switched to `>= 2.0, < 3.0` where it made sense and added a migration/rollback checklist. CI now runs `terraform init -reconfigure` + `terraform plan` for each workspace in the matrix.

zoe: nice. when the CI plan for prod is green, i'm happy to approve and we can pick a 30-min cutover window. :thumbsup:

matt: i'll queue a manual prod-plan run after lunch and keep an eye on state locks. ping me if you want me to take the lock during the merge. :eyes:

arjun: thanks all — i'll keep the PR draft until we've got a green prod plan and then move to ready-for-review. tagging @ops on-call for the potential cutover window in the PR description.

luis: fyi i pushed a tiny runner image bump to ensure terraform 1.5.x and provider sdk compatibility — that should avoid unexpected plugin errors.

arjun: perfect. i'll include that in the CI matrix notes.

zoe: great coordination, thx.

matt: lgtm other than the minor changelog ask.

sasha: lgtm.

arjun: merging steps checklist (in PR):
- get green plan for all workspaces
- announce cutover 15m before merge
- merge & monitor CI apply jobs
- verify critical routes/metrics for 30m
- rollback: revert PR + re-run `terraform init -upgrade` on ci

arjun: ping me if you want owner access to the branch or want me to run the prod plan for you.
